summary:
Implementation plan for the 4 design-system structural specifications on the Clients screen:
1. Client directory main container with #FFFFFF fill and 2px padding, inner container with #f8f8f8 fill.
2. Search input field with #f1f1f1 fill and #ededed stroke.
3. Recently viewed client cards main container with #FFFFFF fill and 2px padding, individual cards with #f8f8f8 fill and 2px gap.
4. Right column main container with #FFFFFF fill and 2px padding, housing Client Profile, Body Measurement History, and Order History with #f8f8f8 fill and 2px gap between each container.
